met_analysis:
The Well-Marked Low Pressure Area over southeast Rajasthan & neighbourhood persisted over the same region at 1430 hrs IST of today, the 01st August, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height. It is very likely to move west-northwestwards across South Rajasthan and weaken further into a Low Pressure Area during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jaisalmer, centre of Well-Marked Low Pressureoversoutheast Rajasthan and neighbourhood, Banda, Dehri, Malda, thence eastwards towards Manipur.
The trough from southwest Rajasthan to northeast Bihar across centre of Well-Marked Low Pressureoversoutheast Rajasthan and neighbourhood, northern parts of Madhya Pradesh, southeast Uttar Pradesh and extends upto 4.5 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height persists.
The offshore trough at mean sea level from South Gujarat to Kerala persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Himachal Pradesh & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Himachal Pradesh & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
